subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Naendelea na barua yangu kuhusu kuendesha akaunti zilizowekewa fedha kwa {Brand}. Jambo moja lenye thamani ya kurudiwa: tunaboresha kuelekea akaunti iliyowekewa fedha pekee na tunaisoma nyuma kupitia postback ya S2S baada ya KYC kupita, hivyo unalipa kwa waweka-fedha waliothibitishwa, kama ubora ambao Nubank na Revolut hujenga juu yake. Kwa kiwango tunadumisha akaunti 1,200 zilizowekewa fedha kwa siku. Je, ningekutumia mchanganuo kutoka usajili hadi uwekaji fedha?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account (akaunti iliyowekewa fedha) proof via S2S postback after KYC
illustrative_flags: akaunti 1,200 zilizowekewa fedha kwa siku (daily funded-account volume, MobUpps-specific, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 sw Kenya fintech_banking_and_payments: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (optimize to funded account + S2S postback after KYC, pay on validated depositors); peers from parent only (Nubank, Revolut); one illustrative figure (1,200 funded accounts/day); soft CTA, 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' (states positive via kama/hivyo); curated Latin tokens kept (S2S, KYC, USD-free here).
